context: This criteria evaluates the correct implementation and usage of plugins to extend request functionality.

checklist.name: Plugin function creation
checklist.description: Creates plugin functions with the correct signature that accept the request object as a parameter

checklist.name: Plugin application
checklist.description: Uses the .use() method to apply plugins to requests

checklist.name: Plugin chaining
checklist.description: Demonstrates that multiple plugins can be chained together by calling .use() multiple times
